Outside these formulaic lists, they occur in the patriarchal narratives: Abram and Lot separate while 'the Canaanite and the Perizzite were dwelling in the land' (Gen 13:7), and Jacob fears retaliation from them after the Shechem incident (Gen 34:30). The etymology may connect to פְּרָזָה ('unwalled settlement'), suggesting open-country dwellers, though this remains uncertain."
